title: Awesome Buttery Brazilian Flour Pancakes
description: A delicious and kid-friendly Brazilian dish featuring plain flour, these pancakes are buttery and dense, perfect for a paleo-friendly meal. They are easy to make and fun to eat.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, milk, melted butter, salt, and sugar until smooth.
Let the batter rest for 30 minutes to allow the flour to absorb the liquid.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes hot with your favorite toppings, such as maple syrup, honey, or fresh fruit.
Repeat the cooking process until all the batter is used up.
Keep the cooked pancakes warm in a low-temperature oven while cooking the remaining batter.
